headline: Revenue and cash flow surge, but net loss widens sharply
summary_short: Clearway's Q1 FY2026 revenue rose to $354M (+18.8% y/y, +14.2% q/q) and EBITDA grew to $262M (+20.2% y/y), but net loss widened to -$163M from -$3M a year ago as diluted EPS fell to -$1.35 from $0.03.
summary_long: Revenue rose 18.8% y/y and 14.2% q/q to $354M. Gross margin expanded to 62.1% (from 59.1% y/y, 51.9% q/q). EBITDA grew 20.2% y/y to $262M, and operating income turned positive at $20M from breakeven a year ago. Despite the operating gains, net loss widened to -$163M (diluted EPS -$1.35) from -$3M (EPS $0.03) a year ago and from -$104M q/q. Operating cash flow rose sharply to $401M from $95M y/y. Cash grew to $325M, up 9.4% y/y and 40.7% q/q; long-term debt fell 2.0% q/q to $8,504M but rose 17.6% y/y from $7,231M.
